profile.name: IEEE 488/GPIB 实验仪器
profile.description: 通过 IEEE 488（GPIB）总线连接和控制的台式实验仪器，如万用表、示波器、信号源或电源。此类设备常用于实验室自动化测试、状态查询、触发同步以及保存或恢复仪器配置。
profile.description_en: A bench-top laboratory instrument connected and controlled through the IEEE 488 (GPIB) bus, such as a multimeter, oscilloscope, signal generator, or power supply. Devices in this class are commonly used for automated testing, status monitoring, trigger synchronization, and saving or recalling instrument configurations.
